notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi's soulbond ability by paying {1}{U}, exiling Derevi and returning it to the battlefield.
Deadeye Navigator and Derevi trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye navigator trigger, pairing Deadeye Navigator with Derevi.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
